name: d3-floorspec
description: D3 Floorspec — reference implementation of the Floorspec house-as-code standard: engine, editor, MCP server.

paragraphs: The reference implementation of Floorspec, an open standard for describing houses as code. Design a house with Claude: you draw and decide, Claude proposes changes over MCP, and every change is validated, attributed and reviewable. 2D first, 3D, materials and furniture are derived from the same model, and advisory building-code findings come with citations.
New here? Start with the public pages — no account needed:
drop a Floorspec document or .floorspec package and the reference engine validates it and draws it in 2D and 3D in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

requirements.text: Start with the public pages — no account needed:
There is no public sign-up: the operator account comes from first-run setup and every other account from an invite, and Sign in with D3 Auth links to an existing account rather than creating one.
To use it without an invite, self-host it (below).

Self-hosted with Docker Compose (deploy/compose.yml; locally, ./deploy/dev-env.sh then docker compose -f deploy/compose.yml -f deploy/compose.dev.yml up -d --build --wait and open — the first visit creates the operator account).
